basis: 用户：我希望可以追加足够的额度测试到 06 完成，并指出上次粘贴后程序退出令人困惑。按此明确继续和足额授权设置有限收尾批次，不再逐次询问启动增量。
remainingScope: steady state and native switching measurements
unchanged: installation/fault/cleanup limits unchanged; original tasks/candidate/proofs retained; no real model calls or remote business writes
retryPolicy: No blind automatic retries; each failed round retained, diagnose and correct before any bounded rerun; original counters remain cumulative
humanFailure: Retain window and red status until agent explains and explicitly finishes; current 20-minute deadline remains independent fallback
